items.title: Hold a day
items.body: Touch and hold a workout day in the week strip on Train to move it, swap it with another workout, edit it or plan a sport that day.

items.title: Build as I go
items.body: Unplanned session? Start empty and add exercises as you train. Coach suggests what's next.

items.title: Start fresh
items.body: Want a totally new plan? Training profile → Start fresh. Keep your answers or answer again; history, PRs and XP stay.

items.title: Fuel
items.body: New tab: food pointers for each day's training, 200+ recipes, meal plans, a grocery list and a fridge scan.

items.title: Monkey grows with you
items.body: Every 4 weeks a block review levels your plan up, auto-tune fits each day's workout to your sleep and sore muscles, and your growth path shows when you'll hit your goal.

items.title: Built for heavy lifters
items.body: Peak a lift for a test day with Lift Focus, pick top sets, drops or myo-reps per exercise, and see your rep records in Lift Lab.

items.title: Rewards for every day
items.body: Streak shields save a missed week, a Comeback quest after a break, and every finish shows 3 wins, even on a tough day.
